cohort: All successively born twin pairs (≥ 23 weeks of gestation) and their mothers at a tertiary care hospital in India from January to September 2005
finding: Shorter gestation and low birth weight were significantly associated with adverse neonatal outcomes in twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery did not significantly affect neonatal morbidity or mortality in twin pregnancies.
birth_weight: Low birth weight associated with adverse neonatal outcomes
